entities.summary: Benvenuto "Nuto" Revelli was an Italian author, historian and partisan. A Second World War veteran who survived Italy's disastrous foray into Russian territory and its subsequent retreat, Revelli became well known for his book Mai Tardi about the ordeal. For his book Il mondo dei vinti, he collected oral history accounts of 85 country dwellers around Cuneo in northwestern Italy.
